traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

reactions.name: Snap Retreat
reactions.description: When a creature misses the goblin with a melee attack, the goblin can move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.description: The hobgoblin deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a target it hits with an attack if an ally of the hobgoblin is within 5 feet of the target and the ally isn't incapacitated.

reactions.name: Shield Block
reactions.description: When a creature hits the hobgoblin with a melee attack, it can add 2 to its AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

reactions.name: Tail Swipe
reactions.description: When a creature within 10 feet hits the dragon with a melee attack, the dragon can make a tail attack against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

legendary_actions.description: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Detect
actions.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Tail Attack
actions.description: The dragon makes a tail attack.

actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

lair_actions.description: While fighting inside its lair, a legendary dragon can use lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the dragon takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects:

actions.name: Magma Eruption
actions.description: Magma erupts from a point on the ground the dragon can see within 120 feet of it, creating a 20-foot-high, 5-foot-radius geyser. Each creature in the geyser's area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Tremor
actions.description: A tremor shakes the lair in a 60-foot radius around the dragon. Each creature other than the dragon on the ground in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Volcanic Gases
actions.description: Volcanic gases form a cloud in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

reactions.name: Venomous Riposte
reactions.description: When missed by a melee attack, the dragon can spit acidic saliva, dealing 4 (1d8) acid damage to the attacker.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales poisonous gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

legendary_actions.description: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn.

actions.name: Detect
actions.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Tail Attack
actions.description: The dragon makes a tail attack.

actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

lair_actions.description: While fighting inside its lair, the green dragon can use lair actions on initiative count 20:

actions.name: Thick Roots and Vines
actions.description: Grasping roots and vines sprout in a 20-foot radius centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. That area treats terrain as difficult, and creatures starting their turn there must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be restrained.

actions.name: Cloud of Fog
actions.description: A cloud of thick fog fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet. The fog heavily obscures the area until initiative count 20 on the next round.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the dragon is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

reactions.name: Static Discharge
reactions.description: When a creature hits the dragon with a metal melee weapon, it takes 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales a line of lightning 90 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

legendary_actions.description: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn.

actions.name: Detect
actions.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Tail Attack
actions.description: The dragon makes a tail attack.

actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

lair_actions.description: While fighting inside its lair, the blue dragon can use lair actions on initiative count 20:

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.description: A section of lightning streaks down from the ceiling to a point the dragon can see within 120 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save.

actions.name: Sandstorm
actions.description: Creating a swirling cloud of sand, the area becomes heavily obscured until initiative count 20 of the next round.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.description: When the lich sees a creature casting a spell within 60 feet, it attempts to interrupt the spellcasting as a reaction.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute.

legendary_actions.description: The lich can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The lich regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Cantrip
actions.description: The lich casts a cantrip.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The lich uses its Paralyzing Touch.

actions.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The lich fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute.

actions.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
actions.description: Each non-undead creature within 20 feet of the lich must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

lair_actions.description: The lich can use lair actions within its lair on initiative count 20:

actions.name: Spell Slot Restoration
actions.description: The lich rolls a d8 and regains a spell slot of that level or lower. If it has no spent spell slots of that level or lower, nothing happens.

actions.name: Negative Energy Tether
actions.description: The lich targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. Whenever the lich takes damage, the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take damage equal to half the damage dealt to the lich.

actions.name: Spectral Apparitions
actions.description: Apparitions materialize and attack one creature that the lich can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.
